title: costroid.yml
description: The repository's one Costroid configuration file. Every key is optional, and a repository with no file gets the defaults. The server reads this file from the pull request's base commit, never its head.

comment.description: The sticky comment on a pull request.

show_cost.description: Whether a public repository's comment prints amounts. Off, it shows the verdict and the grades, and the rows and the check run's machine block keep the amounts. A private repository always prints them.

policy_pack.description: The policy pack this repository is held to. Reserved: this release reads no pack.

budget_owner.description: Who answers for this repository's budget, as an SCM login or team. Reserved: this release reads no owner.

assumptions.description: Assumption defaults for static estimates. Reserved: this release makes no estimate, so the keys inside are not defined yet.

catalog.description: The price catalog version to pin. Reserved: this release uses the catalog it embeds.

agents.description: The agents that run in CI. Reserved: the workflow decides this today.
